2026-11-20DFOFisheries ActRegulations Amending the Marine Mammal Regulations (Southern Resident Killer Whale Approach Distance) Regulations Amending the Marine Mammal Regulations (Southern Resident Killer Whale Approach Distance) in order to (1) increase the approach distance prescribed in the regulation for the Southern Resident killer whale (SRKW) in Canadian Pacific fisheries waters from 200 metres to 1,000 metres; and (2) make clarifying technical amendments to terminology, and other corrections and updates to address minor inconsistencies and outdated language.N/A
subject: Regulations Amending the Marine Mammal Regulations (Southern Resident Killer Whale Approach Distance)
precis: Regulations Amending the Marine Mammal Regulations (Southern Resident Killer Whale Approach Distance) in order to (1) increase the approach distance prescribed in the regulation for the Southern Resident killer whale (SRKW) in Canadian Pacific fisheries waters from 200 metres to 1,000 metres; and (2) make clarifying technical amendments to terminology, and other corrections and updates to address minor inconsistencies and outdated language.
